title: Chapel of Hakoris
summary: This bark station has differently placed doorways and a rear support for the portable shrine.
orientation: Outside the First Pylon, near the western water approach.

claims.text: This bark station has differently placed doorways and a rear support for the portable shrine.
The source interprets the north and west doors as allowing the bark to enter and leave without changing its north-facing prow orientation.
Open papyrus columns and low screen walls contrast with its more enclosed eastern half.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
